bio_en: Vahe Artsruni, baptised Meliqset Muradian, was born in 1889 in Kaghpi in Shatakh, into the line of the Armenian meliks of Shatakh. His father was killed in the Hamidian terror of 1896, and he was raised in the American orphanage in Van, graduating from the American school in 1903. In 1904 he joined the revolutionary bands and, under Koms, went back to his native district to organise. In 1906 he went to America, studied at Harvard and graduated in international law in 1913.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Later career and death not read (article by Hayk Ohanian, Alik 1958).
